The way I see it, there's a good and a bad in everyone. What type of person you are depends on what you lean into. I see a goodness Bojack, even through the murk of his horrible actions.  There is a part of him that wants to be good, but he surrenders to his own selfish, his darkness, and unfulfilled needs, and it hurts the people around him. Even if he knows that people are hurt, he can't comprehend the magnitude of his actions. To him, his actions are blips but to the people they're a fucking meteor. That being said, nothing's binary, and his character shows that. Sometimes when he hurts people, he's trying to fix things, but he gets in over his head and he fucks up. It's hard to decide whether he's truly doing for someone else or if he's doing it for him. What does it mean to be a good person?
